## Problem
Two players flip a fair coin in turns; the first to flip heads wins. What is the chance that the player who flips first wins?

## Solution
**2/3.** If $p$ is the first player's chance, then $p = \tfrac12 + \tfrac12 (1 - p)$, so $p = \tfrac23$.
